tasks.subject: Implement Phase 0-1 telemetry and warmup readiness gate
tasks.description: Implement the plan's Phase 0 baseline telemetry + measurement harness and Phase 1 warmup readiness gate in the Wisp codebase. Add correlated utterance timing, structured logs, debug summary path, explicit warmup state management, distinct warmup completion/failure logging, and tests for warmup transitions/hotkey behavior.

tasks.subject: Implement Phase 2 hot capture engine lifecycle
tasks.description: Refactor AudioCapture and coordinator lifecycle per the STT latency plan so engine lifecycle is separated from recording lifecycle. Keep AVAudioEngine/tap/converter armed while idle, add prepare/arm/begin/end/shutdown style APIs, handle startup/teardown cleanly, and add/update tests for the revised capture flow.

tasks.subject: Implement Phase 3-4 ring buffer, pre-roll, and adaptive stop grace
tasks.description: Build the bounded float ring buffer + pre-roll path and adaptive stop grace logic from the STT latency plan. Ensure pre-roll is prepended once per utterance, telemetry includes prepended duration, stop grace is deterministic/testable, and add unit tests for ring buffer and grace calculations.

tasks.subject: Harden telemetry docs and update the implementation plan
tasks.description: Update the plan document with benchmark script refinements, acceptance thresholds, and results placeholders/notes based on implemented telemetry. Do not fabricate measurements; add the markdown structure needed to record before/after numbers and ship criteria decisions.
